newsitem.title: USA: M.A. Hanna sets goal of $4 bln revs in 2001.
newsitem.headline: M.A. Hanna sets goal of $4 bln revs in 2001.

text.p: The M.A. Hanna Co said Wednesday that it had set specific fiancial goals to achieve in the next five years.
Among them, said the company was the gaol of achieveing $4 billion in sales in the year 2001. Revenues totaled $2.1 billion in 1996.

The company said it also wants intenrnational sales to account for 25 percent of revenue, or $1 billion. International sales accounted for 21 percent of 1996 revenues, ahead of the 20 percent goal for the year.

Over the next five years, the company said it is aiming for a faster rate of earnings than sales growth, and that it is looking to achieve a areturn on equit of 15 percent and a return on invested capital of 20 percent.
The company added that it also has the financial strength to fund all of its initiatives.
M.A. Hannah is a paroducer of specialty chemcials.
